subject: ela
intro: When you listen to a text read aloud or watch a video, you can find the main idea (what it is mostly about) and key details that support it. Listening carefully helps you remember the information. Third graders find the main idea and details from what they hear or see.

items.prompt:
You hear: 'Recycling helps the earth. It saves trees and keeps trash out of landfills.'

What is the main idea?

steps: The main idea is what it is mostly about.
It is about how recycling helps the earth.
So the main idea is that recycling helps the earth.

items.prompt:
You hear (same text).

Name one DETAIL that supports the main idea.

steps: So one detail is that recycling saves trees.
solution.answer: It saves trees (or keeps trash out of landfills).

items.prompt: What should you do while listening to remember the main idea and details?

steps: Listening carefully (and taking notes) helps you remember.

items.prompt:
You hear: 'Exercise keeps your body strong and your heart healthy.'

Main idea?

steps: Exercise is good for you / keeps you healthy.

items.prompt: To remember what you hear, you should ____.
